title: OrderingOrderExpiredPayload
description: Payload of `ordering.order.expired` version 1. An order was not paid within the platform's window (`ordering.unpaid_expiry_minutes`) and expired: every hold released, anything taken refunded; the customer's basket still holds what they chose and the order is not listed. The envelope's `partner_id` is the store's Partner and its `correlation_id` follows the order. Read the order at `GET /v1/platform/orders/{order_id}`, `GET /v1/customer/orders/{order_id}` or the store's route. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

number.description: The order's number, as said aloud.

partner_id.description: The store's Partner; the envelope's `partner_id` too.

customer_id.description: The customer (a user id); fetch personal data from the API when it is needed.

previous_status.description: The status before; `null` for a first status.

version.description: The order's version after the change; it only rises, and signals carry it.

currency.description: The currency of every amount, in its minor unit.

released_amount.description: What was held and let go.

refunded_amount.description: What was taken and goes back.
